cohort: 4 young women (21-33 years old) with cervical high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL)
finding: HiPorfin® PDT for cervical HSIL was safe, did not adversely affect fertility, and resulted in healthy, full-term infants.
mod_finding: Three patients delivered vaginally and one delivered by C-section to healthy infants at term.
